text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Hosted API (us-east-1) p99 latency > 12s, sustained for 3m. Request queue rising (~45k). GPU pool 'hosted-prod-1' util=99%. Autoscaler errors: "provisioner: quota_exceeded" and "max_pool_size_reached". Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/alerts/8601234567

maria (oncall): taking pager. on it. @kevin can you pull the autoscaler logs?

kevin: looking. quick metrics: p50=120ms p95=2.1s p99=12.4s. queue.len=45,300. avg_kvcache_hit=7%. gpu_util=98.7%. autoscaler log tail:
```
2026-03-17T03:21:12Z ERROR provisioner: CreateInstance failed: quota_exceeded
2026-03-17T03:21:13Z WARN  autoscaler: desired=24 current=18 max_pool=18
2026-03-17T03:21:14Z ERROR leader: lease wait > 30s
```

sre-lead-jen: rough ask: reduce GPU pressure by shifting some traffic to smaller/quantized model variants and enable per-tenant graceful throttles. Can we flip a routing rule?

eng-platform: we have a hot path: can run a quick routing override to send non-critical keys to cpu-quantized-1 model. command:
```bash
redwood route override --region us-east-1 --match "plan:free OR tag:experiment" --target cpu-quantized-1 --ttl 15m
```
I'll run if ops approves.

maria (oncall): do it. prioritize preserving SLA for paid tiers. put a note to CS.

eng-platform: running now...
```
INFO override started id=ovr-20260317-001
INFO matched 437 tenants, 6.2k rps rerouted
```

kevin: override accepted by edge, seeing immediate drop in GPU queue growth rate (queue delta -9k over 2m). p99 down to ~8.6s. good signal but still high. autoscaler still failing on provisioning due to cloud quota.

customer-success-lucy: receiving reports: some free-tier customers seeing 503s, one enterprise customer (acme-ml) reporting elevated timeouts on their batch job. sending status note to impacted list.

carol: do we have fallback model for acme-ml specific route? can we force-sticky them to dedicated-evictable?

eng-platform: acme-ml is on default hosted. we can set a temporary priority exemption for paid enterprise, but pool max prevents adding nodes. alternative: enable per-tenant throttles for experimental/low-value keys and increase cache TTLs for embeddings to reduce recurring compute.

maria (oncall): action items: 1) enable routing override (done), 2) ephemeral throttles for non-paid (eng-platform), 3) raise cache TTLs (kevin), 4) open cloud quota increase with provider (ops-bot).

kevin: cache TTLs bumped for common prompt templates, reduced rps by ~1.3k. applied quick rate-limit: `ratelimit set global:free_tier 10rps` - confirmed in edge logs.

ops-bot: Ticket created: CLOUD-INC-5871 -> Provider request: increase GPU quota in us-east-1 by +8 (priority=urgent). Estimated provider ETA 2-4 hours.

kevin: still seeing p99 ~6.2s, queue 30k and decreasing slowly. autoscaler errors now show "quota pending approval".

sre-lead-jen: if provider ETA is long, fallback plan B: spin up warm preemptible nodes in another region and enable cross-region routing for some traffic. That will increase latency for those requests but keeps services up. Thoughts?

maria (oncall): prefer to avoid cross-region for enterprise customers. plan B opt-in only for free/experimental traffic. proceed with plan B for low-tier traffic. @eng-platform please prepare cross-region route with low priority.

eng-platform: prepping cross-region route to us-east-2 preemptible pool. will only route <5% traffic and only non-paid keys.

customer-success-lucy: posted interim status to impacted customers: "We're seeing elevated latencies in US-East due to capacity constraints. We're throttling non-critical traffic and working with our cloud provider to add capacity. Paid customers prioritized. We'll update in 30m." :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

kevin-noc: taking handoff for night shift. summary: override active, cache+ratelimit in place, provider ticket filed. queue trending down but monitor for rebound. handoff docs: https://confluence.redwood.ai/incidents/8601234567/hand_off

maria (oncall): thanks @kevin-noc. assigning postmortem to @sre-lead-jen + @eng-platform to follow up root cause (autoscaler quota handling + soft limits). please include an action to add better preflight checks and early degradation rules.

sre-lead-jen: noted. will schedule postmortem and include suggested runbook updates (auto-fallback to model variants, per-tenant throttles, cloud quota pre-warnings).

maria (oncall): closing live thread for now. continue monitoring in #incidents-ops. escalate if queue growth reverses or p99 > 10s again. :white_check_mark:
